turns.assessment: The alleged degradation is not corroborated by the case data: svc116 has no recorded symptom, every listed service is OK, and receiver quality metrics on all three constituent lightpaths (och76, och26, and och29) showed no change. This strongly argues against line, amplifier, span, WSS, or receiver faults; the documented client-port fault is also a hard-down mode rather than a quality degradation. The cause cannot be identified from the available evidence.

proposals.rationale: A channel-specific filter shift can reduce quality without changing optical power, but unchanged pre-FEC BER and estimated OSNR on the service's constituent lightpaths, plus the absence of any service symptom, weigh strongly against it.

proposals.rationale: A receiver-local penalty could selectively degrade traffic toward S10, but this receiver reported no change in pre-FEC BER, estimated OSNR, power, DGD, or SOP rate, and other services using S21-S10 remain OK.
